input: Country: Belgium. Purchaser Name: VITO. Summary: Rental of Buffer and Mixing Tanks. Description: For a project, VITO must be able to buffer wastewater from 5 chemical companies in buffer tanks. From here, the wastewater is pumped in a certain mixing ratio to a mixing tank. From this mixing tank the waste water is offered to a mobile treatment unit consisting of filtration and membrane techniques. The final effluent is pumped to the discharge point. The waste water supplied by the companies has already been purified in their water treatment plant and meets the current discharge standards of the individual companies. This is discharged into surface water. Quality wastewater: The total salt content (TDS) of the wastewater varies between 1 and 10 g/L with chloride concentrations between 0.4 and 4 g/L. The pH is neutral and the concentration of organic substances is low (COD concentrations between 30 and 130 mg/l. To buffer these wastewaters, VITO is looking for a number of buffer tanks and mixing tanks, which can be rented for a period of at least 4 months. Extension of a few months should be possible.<br> Category (CPV code): Tanks, reservoirs and containers, central-heating radiators and boilers (44600000). Published Date: 2025-11-13. Description: This public contract concerns the framework agreement for multimedia infrastructure and audiovisual support for the buildings of the contracting authority. The contract is divided into two lots: Lot 1 Supply, installation, training and maintenance of multimedia infrastructure This plot concerns the purchase of new multimedia infrastructure and associated services. On the one hand, it includes the supply of audiovisual equipment on the basis of a product catalogue, in which tenderers must quote a price per product (the so-called "Quoted Products"). In addition the parcel includes support services, including: the coordination, installation and configuration of the infrastructure provided, training for users, technicians and administrators, and the maintenance of both the newly purchased and the existing multimedia infrastructure. Lot 2 Audiovisual support during events and meetings This lot concerns the provision of audiovisual support in the context of the organization of events and meetings in the buildings of the contracting authority. The contractor will be responsible for the temporary rental, installation, configuration and technical assistance of the necessary audiovisual equipment (screens, projectors, sound amplification, microphones, videoconferencing systems, etc.). Description: The assignment concerns the delivery of hot, high-quality and balanced meals via cold line and fruit porridge to the daycare centers of the EVA non-profit organization Gemeentelijke Kinderopvang Dilbeek. The EVA non-profit organization Municipal Childcare Dilbeek has been awarded the contract to care for 109 children aged from 0 to 3 years, spread over three daycare centers.
